Should we change her name ? Is yes which name is better for her . She was born on 3rd March 1985 and my parents names are : Mother : Shahnaz Begum Father : Mohammed Rahmathulla. Please advice . Question: Assalamalaikum, my sister's name is Yasmeen Taj, however she is facing a lot of trouble in her married life and her health. Should we change her name ? Is yes which name is better for her . She was born on 3rd March 1985 and my parents names are : Mother : Shahnaz Begum Father : Mohammed Rahmathulla. Please advice . Jazakallahu Khair. ASsalamalaikum. Answer ID: 30467 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 367/274/L=1432) Yasmeen means: Jasmine tree. Taj means: Crown, officer, feather crest. These names and their meanings are correct. However, if you do not like this name, you can choose any of the names of Sahabiyat for your satisfaction. It is wrong to believe that names create trouble. Ask your sister to recite the following dua 500 times daily, in-sha-Allah, all her troubles shall end: حَسْبُنَا اللّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
